blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an
affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how such a head should be wired into
a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature
into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops
the policy below the headless base ( 85.5 % 85.5\% vs. 93.1 % 93.1\% ). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2 × 2 2{\times}2 ablation over
injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant
lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2 % 96.2\% , matching the far more elaborate three-expert
AffordanceVLA ( 95.8 % 95.8\% ) with under 1 % 1\% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input
hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes
load-bearing.

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have rapidly become the dominant recipe for language-conditioned robot manipulation. A large vision-language backbone, pretrained on internet-scale image-text data, is fine-tuned by imitation to map camera observations and a natural-language instruction to low-level actions [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . The recipe inherits the backbone’s open-vocabulary perception and its language grounding, and recent flow-matching action experts [ 5 ] have pushed success rates on standard benchmarks such as LIBERO [ 9 ] above the 90% mark. Yet the supervision these models receive is curiously indirect. The action loss constrains only the trajectory ; nothing in the objective ever tells the model where in the scene the interaction should happen. Which object the instruction refers to, which part of it to grasp, and where to place it must all be discovered implicitly, by correlating pixels with future gripper positions across the demonstration corpus.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言动作(VLA)模型迅速成为了语言条件机器人操纵的主导食谱. 一个大型的视觉语言主干线,在互联网规模的图像文本数据上经过预先培训,通过模仿相机观测图和对低级动作的自然语言指导来进行微调[2,3,4,5,6]. 食谱继承了骨干开放的活泼感知及其语言基础,最近流相匹配的行动专家[5]将成功率推向标准基准,如超过90%的LIBERO[9]。 然而,这些模型得到的监督是间接的。 动作损失只制约了轨迹;目标中没有任何东西告诉模型在现场应在哪里发生相互作用. 指示指的是哪一个对象,它要抓住的哪一部分,并将其放置在何处,都必须通过将像素与未来夹住的姿势联系起来,从而隐含地发现。

blocks.en: The failure modes of imitation-trained VLAs mirror this gap. In our experiments, a strong 2B-parameter policy is nearly saturated on suites that test object diversity or spatial layout ( 98 + % 98{+}\% ), but loses most of its remaining errors in two places. The first is instruction disambiguation : scenes containing several plausible targets where only the language picks out the right one. The second is long-horizon tasks , where a small placement error early in the episode compounds. Both are precisely the situations in which an explicit, spatially grounded notion of “the place to act next” should help.
blocks.zh: 模仿训练的VLA的失败模式反映了这一差距. 在我们的实验中,一个强大的2B参数政策在测试物体多样性或空间布局的套房上几乎被饱和了(98+% 98+%),但在两个地方丢失了它剩下的大部分错误. 第一个是指示分解:包含几个可能的目标的场景, 第二个是长视距任务, 这两种情况恰恰都是“下一步行动之地”这一明确、基于空间的概念应当有所帮助的情况。

blocks.en: Affordances offer exactly that notion. The term, originating in ecological psychology [ 1 ] , denotes the action possibilities a scene offers an agent; in robot learning it has been operationalized as dense maps of contact or interaction regions [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] . Affordance labels are attractive as auxiliary supervision for three reasons. First, in simulation they are free : the physics engine knows every contact between gripper and object, so pixel-accurate interaction maps can be extracted from existing demonstrations without human labeling. Second, they are dense : a per-pixel heatmap carries orders of magnitude more spatial signal per frame than a single action vector. Third, they are task-aligned : predicting where to interact next requires resolving the instruction, binding it to an object, and localizing a part, which are the exact sub-skills whose failures dominate VLA error budgets.
blocks.zh: 付得起就是这个意思。 该名词起源于生态心理学 [1],表示场景给一种剂能提供的行动可能性;在机器人学习中,它作为密集的接触或互动区域地图被操作 [12,13,14]. 负担的标签作为辅助监督具有吸引力,原因有三. 首先,在模拟中它们是免费的:物理引擎知道抓取器和物体之间的每一个接触,所以像素精确的交互图可以从现有的演示中取出而不用人类标签. 第二,它们是密集的:每像素热图携带的每个帧的空间信号比单个动作矢量的空间信号要多。 第三,它们与任务相匹配: 预测交互的下一步需要解决指令,将其绑定在一个对象上,并且将一个部分本地化,这是准确的子技能,其失败主导了VLA错误预算.

blocks.en: It is therefore no surprise that several recent systems build affordances into VLAs [ 15 , 16 ] . What is surprising is how inconsistent the reported outcomes are, and how much architectural machinery is deployed to make the signal help. AffordanceVLA [ 16 ] , the strongest published system, introduces a purpose-built three-expert mixture-of-transformers with a dedicated affordance-generation expert and a two-stage curriculum, and its own ablation shows that removing the second stage costs almost ten points. Our starting point was the opposite experience: attaching a straightforward affordance head to a VLA and co-training hurt , collapsing instruction-following performance. The same auxiliary task, on the same benchmark, can evidently help or harm depending on integration details that papers rarely state, let alone ablate.
blocks.zh: 因此,毫不奇怪,最近的一些系统将负担能力发展为[15、16]。 令人惊讶的是,所报告的结果有多不一致,以及利用多少建筑机械来帮助信号。 AffonanceVLA [16],最强的已出版系统,引入了专有的由三位专家混合而成的转换器,并配有专有的支付生成专家并配有两阶段课程,它本身的废品表明去掉第二阶段几乎需要10分. 我们的出发点是相反的经验:在志愿军中有一个直截了当的领头人,而共同训练则受到伤害,导致教学跟随性能崩溃。 同样的辅助任务,在同一基准上,根据文件很少说明的整合细节,显然会有所帮助或有伤害,更不用说放弃了。

blocks.en: This paper treats those details as the object of study. Our method rests on three wiring decisions. The first is a stop-gradient : the affordance head reads intermediate backbone layers, but its loss never updates the backbone. This is not a stylistic choice. Ablating it flips the sign of the whole intervention, dropping goal-conditioned success from the 90 90 s to 62 % 62\% and making the head-equipped policy worse than the headless base. With the backbone protected, the head’s only channel of influence on the policy is a single learned bridge that re-injects an intermediate head feature into the visual tokens conditioning the action expert. Contributions. (1) A simple affordance-head recipe (stop-gradient + feature re-injection) that lifts a strong VLA from 93.1 % 93.1\% to 96.2 % 96.2\% average success on LIBERO, on par with the dedicated mixture-of-transformers AffordanceVLA ( 95.8 % 95.8\% ) [ 16 ] at a fraction of its architectural complexity.
(2) A stop-gradient ablation showing gradient isolation is a precondition : with affordance gradients flowing into the backbone, the head makes the policy worse than the headless base ( 85.5 % 85.5\% vs. 93.1 % 93.1\% , with goal-conditioned success collapsing to 62 % 62\% ). The sign of the entire intervention flips on this single bit.
(3) A same-budget 2 × 2 2{\times}2 factorial ablation showing that, once the backbone is protected, initialization of the injection bridge, not its topology, is the dominant lever . Active initialization adds + 2.0 +2.0 / + 2.7 +2.7 points over lazy on the concatenation/residual topologies respectively, a two-way internal replication. Topology contributes at most + 0.5 +0.5 , and only under active initialization.
(4) Two mechanism probes. Ground-truth affordance maps supplied as an input hurt ( − 5.6 -5.6 points), showing the signal must be internalized by prediction rather than injected as data. Inference-time zeroing of the injected feature is a free diagnostic that separates two regimes. Under a lazy bridge the head is a pure training-time regularizer whose benefit survives ablation. Under an active bridge the affordance pathway becomes load-bearing, and it additionally lifts long-horizon success from 82.6 % 82.6\% to 91.4 % 91.4\% .

blocks.en: II RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Vision-language-action models
blocks.zh: 二-A 远景-语言-行动模式

blocks.en: Casting manipulation as next-action prediction on top of a pretrained vision-language model was popularized by RT-2 [ 2 ] , which showed that web-scale semantics transfer into control when actions are emitted as tokens. Subsequent open efforts scaled the recipe across embodiments and datasets: Octo [ 4 ] and OpenVLA [ 3 ] established open-weight generalist policies, π 0 \pi_{0} [ 5 ] replaced autoregressive action decoding with a flow-matching action expert conditioned on backbone features, and GR00T N1 [ 6 ] extended the approach toward humanoid platforms. A parallel line augments the visual side of VLAs with explicit spatial structure, e.g. 3D position encodings in SpatialVLA [ 7 ] or intermediate visual sub-goals in CoT-VLA [ 8 ] . Our study is orthogonal to the backbone choice and concerns only how auxiliary dense supervision should be attached.
blocks.zh: RT-2[2]普及了将操纵作为预先训练的视觉语言模型之上的下个动作预测的铸造,这表明当行动作为象征物被释放出时,网络尺度的语义会转移到控制中去. 随后的开放努力将配方范围扩大到了各种表现和数据集:Octo[4]和OpenVLA[3]确立了开放量的通才政策;以骨干特征为条件的流量匹配行动专家取代了自递性动作解码;GR00T N1[6]将方法扩展到了人造平台。 平行行可以以明显的空间结构来增强VLA的视觉侧面,例如SpaceVLA[7]中的3D位置编码或者COT-VLA[8]中的中间视觉分目标. 我们的研究符合骨干选择的正统性,只关心辅助密集监管应如何附加.

blocks.en: II-B The StarVLA platform and the QwenPI model
blocks.zh: II-B StarVLA 平台和 QuenPI 模型

blocks.en: We conduct all experiments in StarVLA [ 11 ] , an open-source, “Lego-like” codebase for VLA development in which every functional component (model, data pipeline, trainer, configuration, and benchmark evaluation) is factored into plug-and-play modules with high cohesion and low coupling. The platform lets a VLM backbone be paired with interchangeable action experts and evaluated under standardized pipelines across benchmarks including LIBERO, RoboCasa, and CALVIN. This modularity is not incidental to our study but instrumental. A controlled wiring ablation is only meaningful if inserting the head, swapping the bridge topology, or changing an initialization touches nothing else in the stack. StarVLA’s factoring makes each of our variants a small, isolated diff against an otherwise frozen training and evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们在StarVLA [11] 进行所有实验,这是一个开放源代码库,用于VLA开发,其中每个功能部分(模型、数据管道、训练员、配置和基准评价)都被纳入具有高度凝聚力和低耦合性的插值和游戏模块。 该平台允许一个VLM主干线与可互换的行动专家对接,并在LIBERO、RoboCasa和CALVIN等基准的标准化管道下进行评估。 这种模块性不是我们研究的附带内容,而是有用的。 只有在插入头部,换取桥面地貌,或改变初始化时,才有意义。 StarVLA的保理工作使我们的每一种变体都成为一个小而孤立的diff,以对抗原本被冻结的培训和评估管道。

blocks.en: Our base policy is StarVLA’s QwenPI instantiation, which realizes the π 0 \pi_{0} design [ 5 ] on a modern open backbone. A Qwen3-VL-2B VLM [ 10 ] , a natively multimodal model pairing a ViT vision tower with a language decoder, encodes the camera views and the instruction. Action generation is delegated to a layerwise flow-matching action expert : a DiT that carries a noisy action chunk and denoises it under a conditional flow-matching objective, attending at each of its layers to the hidden states of the corresponding VLM layer. Compared with autoregressive action tokenization [ 2 , 3 ] , this keeps actions continuous and chunked while letting the expert read the backbone at every depth, which is precisely the interface our affordance bridge later writes into.
blocks.zh: 我们的基本政策是StarVLA的QuenPI即兴表演, A Qwen3-VL-2B VLM [10],一种本土多模式相配ViT视觉塔并配有语言解码器,编码相机视图和指令. 动作生成被委托给一个分层相容的相容动作专家:一个DiT,它携带有吵闹的动作块并用有条件相容相容的相容目标把它弄出来,在它的每个层都到相应的VLM层的隐藏状态. 与自递式动作符号化[2,3]相比,这保持了动作的连续和块状,同时让专家在每一个深度读取主干线,而这正是我们后期所写的接口.

blocks.en: II-C Affordances for manipulation
blocks.zh: 支付操纵费用

blocks.en: The original notion of affordance, the action possibilities an environment offers [ 1 ] , entered robot learning as the problem of predicting where and how an agent can interact. Where2Act [ 12 ] learns per-pixel actionability scores for articulated objects from simulated interaction; VRB [ 13 ] distills contact regions and post-contact trajectories from human videos; MOKA [ 14 ] elicits affordance points from a VLM zero-shot via visual prompting and executes them open-loop. These works treat the affordance predictor as the product . Closer to us are systems that use affordances in service of an end-to-end policy: DeVA [ 15 ] co-trains dense affordance and depth heads on a video-generation backbone for embodied control, and AffordanceVLA [ 16 ] interleaves an affordance-generation expert with action generation inside a three-expert mixture-of-transformers, trained with a two-stage curriculum. Both report that affordance awareness improves manipulation, but both couple the signal to substantial bespoke architecture, which leaves open what the minimal effective coupling is. Our result, a stock VLA plus one head and one linear bridge matching AffordanceVLA on LIBERO, suggests the architecture is not the essential ingredient; the wiring is.

Where2Act [12]从模拟交互中学习出每像素可操作性分数,用于表达物体;VRB [13]从人类视频中分馏出接触区和接触后轨迹;MOKA [14]通过视觉提示从VLM0-shot中取出支付分数,并进行开放执行. 这些作品将价格预测器作为产品。 与我们比较接近的是使用支付能力服务于端到端政策的系统:DeVA [15] 共同在包含控制的视频生成主干上显示密集支付能力和深度头像,AfffonanceVLA [16] 将支付能力生成专家与行动生成者连接在一个具有两阶段课程的三位专家混合转换器内。 这两种报告都改善了操纵,但两者都对实质性的点名架构发出信号,这就打开了最小的有效组合。 我们的结果显示,一个股票VLA加上一个头和一个与LIBERO上的AffonanceVLA相匹配的线性桥,说明该架构不是基本成分;接线就是.

blocks.en: II-D Auxiliary objectives, gradient interference, and bridges
blocks.zh: 二-D 辅助目标、梯度干扰和桥梁

blocks.en: Auxiliary losses have long been used to shape representations, from the self-supervised auxiliary tasks of UNREAL in RL [ 17 ] to depth and segmentation heads in perception stacks. The risk is equally well documented: auxiliary gradients can interfere destructively with the primary task [ 18 ] . Our preliminary experiments reproduce exactly this failure, with the affordance loss collapsing instruction following when backpropagated into the backbone. Our stop-gradient design sidesteps interference structurally rather than algorithmically, at the price of raising a new question: if the auxiliary task cannot alter the backbone, how does it influence the policy at all? The answer runs through the injection bridge, which connects our work to a literature on how to attach new pathways to pretrained models . Zero-initialized connections are the standard conservative choice: ControlNet’s zero convolutions [ 19 ] , Flamingo’s tanh-gated cross-attention [ 20 ] , and the zero-initialized up-projection of LoRA [ 21 ] all guarantee that a new branch starts as an exact identity and grows only as needed. Our central empirical finding is that this orthodoxy can silently fail in the auxiliary-head setting. When the primary task can already be solved from the existing features, the zero-initialized bridge sits at a lazy attractor : it never grows, the injected feature stays runtime-inert, and the head’s benefit reduces to a real but smaller implicit regularization effect. Random initialization is exactly what the adapter literature avoids, because it perturbs the pretrained computation. Yet it is what forces the policy’s representation to form around the affordance pathway, and it is worth more than two points on LIBERO. This inverts the usual guidance and, to our knowledge, has not been isolated before in a VLA setting.

blocks.en: Two properties of this construction matter. First, the label is a look-ahead signal: within a task stage it is constant (the whole approach phase points at the same grasp location) and it switches discretely at stage boundaries (the moment the mug is grasped, the label jumps to the target plate). The head is therefore supervised to predict not the present but the immediate motor future, the same latent decision the policy must make. Second, because the Gaussian template is fixed, the per-frame label mass is constant, so the prediction task never degenerates into predicting label intensity ; only location carries information.
blocks.zh: 这个建筑问题有两个属性。 首先,标签是外观-前方信号:在一个任务阶段内是恒定的(整个取向相位点在同一抓取位置上),在相位边界上进行离散切换(一接取出杯子,标签会跳到目标板上). 因此,主管受到监督,不能预测当前而是眼前的未来,这是政策必须作出的潜在决定。 第二,由于高斯模板是固定的,因此每帧标签质量是常数的,因此预测任务从未退化为预测标签强度;只有位置携带信息.

blocks.en: III-C Affordance head: multi-scale readout of a columnar backbone
blocks.zh: III-C 负担型头:多比例读取一列主干线

blocks.en: Where the head reads from. The head taps the backbone’s hidden states at a small set of uniformly spaced layers. The motivation is the well-established semantic stratification of deep networks: early transformer layers carry local, high-frequency appearance information, while late layers carry increasingly global, language-conditioned semantics. Affordance prediction needs both ends of this spectrum simultaneously. Selecting the correct object among distractors is a late-layer, instruction-conditioned decision, but placing the peak on the mug’s handle to pixel accuracy is an early-layer, appearance-driven one. A single tap would force a choice between the two; uniformly spaced taps hand the head the full hierarchy and let it learn the mixture.
blocks.zh: 头所念之处. 头部将骨干隐藏的状态在一小组相通的平面上。 其动机是深层网络的既定语义分层:早期变压器层承载局部高频外观信息,而后层承载的语义日益全球化,语言条件. 承受得起的预测需要这个频谱的两端同时进行. 在分心器中选择正确的对象是一种后期的,有指导条件的决定,但把顶端放在杯柄上到像素精确度则是早期的,外观驱动的. 单一水龙头将迫使两者之间做出选择;统一间距的水龙头将头部完全分级,让头部学习混合物.

blocks.en: Why a pyramid. A vision transformer is columnar : every layer represents the image at the same, coarse token resolution, unlike convolutional hierarchies whose resolution decreases with depth [ 22 ] . Dense prediction from such a backbone therefore faces the classic tension between recognition and localization. Semantic strength lives in coarse features, while spatial precision requires fine ones. The canonical resolution of this tension is the top-down pyramid with lateral connections, introduced by FPN for object detection [ 23 ] and, in encoder-decoder form, by U-Net for segmentation [ 25 ] . In such a pyramid, coarse and semantically strong features are progressively upsampled and fused at each scale with finer ones, so every output location is informed by both global context and local evidence. DPT [ 26 ] showed how to manufacture the missing multi-scale structure from a columnar ViT by reassembling different layers’ tokens at different synthetic resolutions before running such a pyramid. We adopt this principle for the same first-principles reason it was invented: our output must be sharp at pixel level but selected by global, instruction-level semantics. Concretely, each tapped layer is reassembled onto its own grid, earlier layers onto finer grids to preserve their high-frequency content and later layers onto coarser grids matching their semantic granularity. The grids are fused top-down with lateral connections through a cascade of fusion stages F 0 , … , F M F_{0},\dots,F_{M} (coarse to fine) and decoded to the per-view contact heatmap, trained with binary cross-entropy ℒ aff \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aff}} .

blocks.en: Instruction conditioning. One subtlety of reading a causal multimodal backbone is that the image tokens precede the instruction in the sequence, so under causal attention their hidden states cannot attend to the text that follows. The head therefore receives the instruction through an explicit second route: the instruction token embeddings are pooled and applied as a FiLM modulation [ 24 ] to the readouts and to every fusion stage. The head is thus instruction-conditioned by construction, which is what allows it to place its peak on the commanded object even when an identical distractor is present. It also means the injected feature r r carries an instruction-resolved spatial decision rather than a purely visual saliency map.

blocks.en: III-D The affordance bridge

blocks.en: The stop-gradient leaves the head an isolated observer: accurate, but by default mute with respect to the policy. Everything the head contributes to control therefore flows through a single learned bridge , and the rest of this section develops the bridge from the inside out: which head feature it carries, and the small design space of ways to write that feature into the policy.
blocks.zh: 中途停站让头部留下了被孤立的观察者:准确,但默认在政策上是哑弹. 因此,头部对控制的一切贡献都通过一个单一的有学识的桥来流出,其余部分则从内部发展出桥:桥头的哪个特征,以及将这个特征写入政策的方法的小型设计空间.

blocks.en: The carried feature is not the final heatmap. The heatmap is a one-channel bottleneck: it reports where but discards the head’s intermediate computation about what and why . We instead take the feature r r of an intermediate fusion stage F k F_{k} , chosen because its spatial grid coincides with the backbone’s native visual-token grid. Injection is then token-aligned: each visual token receives the head feature for precisely its own spatial cell. At the same time, F k F_{k} sits late enough in the cascade that coarse semantics and fine localization have already been married. This feature is written into the visual tokens at every conditioning layer of the action expert, so the affordance evidence accompanies the visual stream at whatever depth the expert consults it. Our default writes it as a residual: v l ′ = v l + W aff ​ r (residual) , v_{l}^{\prime}\;=\;v_{l}+W_{\mathrm{aff}}\,r\qquad\text{(residual)}, (5) on the standard grounds of residual learning [ 27 ] : the pretrained visual features, the base policy’s entire working capital, pass through unmodified, and the head contributes a purely additive refinement. blocks.en: The bridge has one further degree of freedom, and it turns out to be the consequential one: how W aff W_{\mathrm{aff}} is initialized. We use a standard Kaiming random scheme ( active ) rather than zero ( lazy ), contradicting the prevailing adapter-design orthodoxy [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] . The zero-initialized bridge looks safer, since the policy starts exactly at the base model. But it must earn its growth from the gradient of the action loss, and that gradient is starved by construction: the head offers information the action expert can, with effort, extract from v l v_{l} anyway. The marginal value of the bridge at W aff = 0 W_{\mathrm{aff}}{=}0 is therefore near zero, and the optimizer never leaves the attractor. Empirically, lazily initialized bridges converge to a few percent of the magnitude of the identity path and are runtime-inert; zeroing them at inference changes nothing (Sec. IV-F ). Active initialization removes the chicken-and-egg problem by fiat. The feature r r is present at full magnitude from step one, the expert’s representation forms around it, and the pathway becomes genuinely load-bearing, at the cost of a violent start: the action loss opens an order of magnitude higher before recovering within a few hundred steps.
blocks.zh: 这座桥还有一等的自由, 我们使用标准的开明随机方案(活性)而不是零(懒性),与流行的适配器-设计正统[19,20,21]相矛盾. 零启动桥看起来比较安全,因为政策完全从基础模型开始。 但是,它必须从动作损失的梯度中获得增长,而梯度则被构造所饿死:头部提供动作专家可以努力从vlv_{l}中提取信息。 在Waff = 0 W_{\ mathrm{aff}}{=}0 的桥的边角值因此接近于零,而优化器则永远不会离开吸引器. 经验性地说,懒散的初始化桥合为身份路径的几分之一,并且是运行时惯性;在推论中将其零化则不会改变任何东西(Sec. blocks.en: III-E What can the head even contribute?
blocks.zh: 三-E类 头还能有什么贡献?

blocks.en: The affordance target is a deterministic function of the observation and instruction, and the head reads the same backbone features the action expert already sees; information-theoretically, r r can offer the policy no new information , only a more explicit format. Any benefit must therefore come from (a) the optimization dynamics induced by the head’s presence, or (b) the explicit format easing the action expert’s job at run time. The two initializations of Sec. III-D turn out to select between exactly these mechanisms, and the experiments below separate them.
blocks.zh: 负担目标是观察和指导的确定性功能,头部读取的是行动专家已经看到的相同的主干;从理论上讲,r不能提供新的信息,只能提供更明确的格式。 因此,任何好处必须来自(a) 负责人在场后引起的优化动态,或(b) 行动专家在运行时简化工作的明确格式。 Sec. III-D的两个初始化结果都是在这些机制中选择的,下面的实验将它们分开.

blocks.en: IV-C Stop-gradient is the precondition
blocks.zh: 四-C 停止升级是先决条件

blocks.en: Fig. 4 makes the case with a three-way comparison: the headless base, the head with its gradient allowed into the backbone, and the same head behind a stop-gradient ( Res-Active ). The first comparison is against our best model. Blocking the gradient is worth 10.7 10.7 points on average ( 85.5 85.5 vs. 96.2 96.2 ), so the stop-gradient is not an optimization detail but the difference between the head helping and the head failing. The second comparison is against the base, and it is the more damning one. The gradient-exposed variant lands 7.6 7.6 points below a model with no head at all: the auxiliary gradient does not merely waste the head, it actively degrades the backbone’s own reasoning. The damage is selective and diagnostic. Object-level success is untouched (a perfect 100 100 ), since recognizing and reaching a unique object needs little language. Goal-conditioned success instead collapses to 62 % 62\% . The auxiliary gradient specifically erodes the backbone’s instruction grounding , the capability bought with vision-language pretraining and consumed most heavily by disambiguation. We suspect this failure mode accounts for much of the mixed evidence on auxiliary heads in the literature. All results in the rest of the paper therefore keep the stop-gradient in place; it is the precondition that makes the remaining 2 × 2 2{\times}2 worth studying.

blocks.en: IV-D Comparison with AffordanceVLA
blocks.zh: IV-D 与付得起的VLA的比较

blocks.en: Table II compares our best variant with AffordanceVLA [ 16 ] , the closest prior work. The two reach essentially the same performance, but by very different means. AffordanceVLA introduces a purpose-built three-expert Mixture-of-Transformers with a dedicated affordance-generation expert and a two-stage training curriculum, and its own ablation shows the design is fragile, dropping to 86.2 % 86.2\% without the second stage. Our result comes from a stock VLA plus one DPT-style head and one linear bridge, which together add under 1 % 1\% to the policy’s parameter count. Training is a single stage with no frozen modules, and the inference-time overhead of running the head is negligible. The entire “architecture” of our method is two wiring decisions. Explicit affordance grounding, in other words, does not require an affordance-specialized architecture. It requires getting the wiring right.

AffonanceVLA引入了专有的由三位翻译专家组成的Mixture-of-Transformers,配备了一位专有的支付生成专家并配备了两阶段的培训课程,它本身的节能显示设计很脆弱,在没有第二阶段的情况下降至86.2% 86.2%. 我们的结果来自一个股票VLA加上一个DPT风格的头和一通线性桥,它们加起来在保险的参数计数中不到1%的1分。 训练是一个单一的阶段,没有被冻结的模块,运行头部的推断时间管理费微不足道. 我们方法的整个“建筑”是两个线性决定。 换句话说,明确的支付基础不需要一个支付得起的专门建筑。 这需要把电线修好

blocks.en: IV-E Probe 1: ground-truth affordances as input are net harmful
blocks.zh: IV-E 探险1:作为投入的地真相费用净有害

blocks.en: Is the affordance signal itself valuable enough that the policy should simply be given it? To test this, we trained a variant that receives the ground-truth affordance heatmap as a third input image, with an oracle rendering the map online at evaluation (in a preliminary configuration of the same pipeline, against its own matched base at 94.0 % 94.0\% average). Despite privileged information, this variant reaches only 88.3 % 88.3\% , a net − 5.6 -5.6 . It is roughly neutral on Object and Spatial but loses 5.5 5.5 on Goal and 19 19 on Long: it specifically damages instruction disambiguation and multi-stage tasks. Externally supplied answers create an input shortcut that competes with the instruction pathway; the signal must be internalized by prediction, not injected as data.
blocks.zh: 付得起的信号本身是否足够宝贵,以至于应该简单地给予它? 为了测试这一点,我们培训了一个变体,接收地面真实承受能力热图作为第三种输入图像,其中的甲骨文在评估时使地图上线(在同一条管道的初步配置中,它本身的对应基数平均为94.0%94.0%)。 尽管有特殊的信息,但这一变体只达到88.3%的88.3%,净值−5.6-5.6。 它在物体和空间方面大致是中立的,但在目标方面损失了5.5 5.5分,在长线方面损失了19 19分:它具体地破坏了指示的混淆和多阶段任务。 外部提供的答案创建了与指令路径相竞争的输入快捷键;信号必须通过预测进行内化,而不是作为数据注入.

blocks.en: IV-F Probe 2: inference-time zeroing separates two regimes
blocks.zh: IV-F 探险2:推论时间 零化分离出两种制度

blocks.en: We replace the injected feature with zeros at inference; the head still runs, only the bridge is silenced. For Cat-Lazy , nothing changes (Goal 94.8 → 95.6 94.8{\rightarrow}95.6 , Long 82.6 → 83.2 82.6{\rightarrow}83.2 , within noise). This is consistent with the small bridge magnitude: the run-time contribution of r r is negligible, yet the variant still beats the base on Goal by + 4.2 +4.2 . The head’s entire benefit in this regime is a training-time regularization effect. Its presence alters the optimization trajectory of the action expert, not the test-time computation. In contrast, in preliminary experiments with an actively initialized bridge, the same ablation collapsed Goal success by 28 28 points: an active pathway becomes load-bearing. The zeroing probe is free to run and we recommend it as a standard diagnostic for auxiliary-task pathways in VLAs.
blocks.zh: 我们用零来取代被注入的特征,在推论中;头还运行,只有桥被沉默. Cat-Lazy,没有什么变化(目标94.8 – 95.6 94.8 rightarrow}95.6,长82.6 → 83.2 82.6 rightarrow}83.2,在噪音中)。 这与小型桥梁规模一致:rr的运行时间贡献可忽略不计,但该变体仍然以+4.2+4.2击败了目标基数. 领导在这一制度中的全部好处是培训时间正规化。 它的存在改变了动作专家的优化轨迹,而不是测试时间的计算. 与此相反,在积极初始化桥梁的初步试验中,同样的衰竭使目标的成功下降了28分:一条活道成为负载道。 零取出探测器可以自由运行,我们推荐它作为VLA中辅助任务路径的标准诊断.

blocks.en: IV-G Head quality is not the bottleneck
blocks.zh: 头部质量不是瓶颈

blocks.en: Across variants the head itself trains to high fidelity: its predicted contact peaks land within a few pixels of ground truth on held-out frames and correctly disambiguate even duplicate objects. Rollout inspection of the remaining Long-suite failures shows correct target selection with second-stage precision errors (e.g., placing onto an occupied burner). The open problem is thus not predicting affordances but transducing them into finer control.
blocks.zh: 在各种变体中,头部本身就训练成高度忠诚:它预测的接触会达到顶峰,在几个像素的地面真象内被挡住,甚至使重复物体正确分解。 对剩余长套故障的推出检查显示,有第二阶段精确误差(例如放入被占用的燃烧器)的目标选择是正确的。 因此,尚未解决的问题不是预测出价,而是将它们转化为更精细的控制。

blocks.en: V LIMITATIONS AND CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 五、限制和结论

blocks.en: Our study is limited to one simulated benchmark, one backbone scale, and one seed per cell, partially mitigated by the two-way replication of the initialization effect and a point-identical retest of the Long suite. Affordance labels also come from privileged simulator state. Within this scope the conclusions are sharp. First, a stop-gradient affordance head with feature re-injection reliably helps. Both actively initialized wirings beat the headless base, Cat-Active by + 2.7 +2.7 points on average and Res-Active by + 3.1 +3.1 , with the gains concentrated on instruction disambiguation and long-horizon precision. Second, the two wiring choices help for separable reasons. Active initialization is the main lever on both topologies: it forces the action expert to build its representation around the affordance pathway instead of leaving the bridge at its lazy attractor. The residual topology adds its own margin on top, chiefly on the Long suite, because its identity path hands the pretrained visual features to the expert untouched, while concatenation re-mixes and slightly degrades them. Res-Active combines both advantages and is the best model in every comparison we ran, matching the purpose-built AffordanceVLA architecture with one head and one linear bridge. More broadly, the wiring bits that most papers leave unstated, bridge initialization and injection topology, swing the result by more than the presence of the head itself. We hope the 2 × 2 2{\times}2 protocol and the zeroing probe become standard reporting practice for auxiliary heads in VLAs.
